text: The original Ethiopians were a highly civilized people; and their laws, their institutions, and especially their religion, and celebrated far and wide. Hence talks to physics as the piety of the Ethiopians, and sends his gods every now and then to read twelve days with that devout people. The Sciland produces a number of very speakers arguments to prove that those two nations equally sprung from the same stock. He mentions a similarity of features, of manners, of anatomy of law, of letters, of the fashion of statuses, and of religion, as evidences of the relation between these two neighboring nations. There was, since every body knows a common, in regard to sacrifice it, even the two countries. The Egyptians sent annually a deputation of their priests, limited with the probable nature of their gods, to visit the fines of the devon Ethiopians. Upon this occasion, a solemal religious banque was prepared, which lasted twelve days, and of which the priest of both nations were parties. It was a kind of sacramental institution, we imagine, by which both parties publicly awarded their agreement in the creation of their religion respectively. These observations plainly show, that the most ancient Ethiopians were people highly utilized in need to much, but the Egyptians were all one time connected to be their scholars. The tone of their language was certainly the same with that of the Chaldeau or Arabica Cunha, whom whom they are descended. We know not whether there are any books in the ancient Ethiopians now act; so that it is not easy to procide instance of its coincidence with the Chaldaic.
